# Linkmapper

Linkmapper builds genetic linkage maps and locates QTL in F2 intercross,
backcross and recombinant inbred line populations, without code. It is a
point-and-click interface to
[onemap](https://cran.r-project.org/package=onemap) and
[R/qtl](https://rqtl.org), with interactive maps, a report, and an R
script that reproduces each analysis.

**Hosted app:** <https://ebenogoe.shinyapps.io/linkmapper/>

![Linkage map with QTL intervals on the F2
demo](reference/figures/06-map.png)

Linkage map with QTL intervals on the F2 demo

## Workflow

1.  **Load data.** MAPMAKER or onemap raw genotype files, with traits in
    the file or from a separate CSV.
2.  **Quality control.** Missing data per marker and individual;
    chi-square segregation tests with Bonferroni correction; marker
    filters.
3.  **Linkage groups.** Two-point recombination fractions and LOD
    scores; grouping by LOD and maximum recombination fraction, with a
    suggested LOD threshold.
4.  **Marker order.** RECORD, RCD, unidirectional growth or seriation;
    Kosambi or Haldane distances; recombination-fraction heatmaps per
    group.
5.  **Linkage map.** Interactive map with positions and group summaries;
    PNG, SVG, PDF, CSV, Excel and MapChart exports.
6.  **QTL mapping.** Interval mapping (Haley-Knott, EM or imputation) or
    composite interval mapping; permutation thresholds; 1.5-LOD support
    intervals, variance explained and effects.
7.  **Export.** Self-contained HTML report, R script and session file.

## Accepted data formats

| Population | Header line | Genotype codes |
|----|----|----|
| F2 intercross | `data type f2 intercross` | A, H, B; C (not BB), D (not AA); `-` missing |
| Backcross | `data type f2 backcross` | A, H; `-` missing |
| RIL, selfing | `data type ri self` | A, B; `-` missing |
| RIL, sib mating | `data type ri sib` | A, B; `-` missing |

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("linkmapper", repos = c("https://ebenogoe.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
linkmapper::run_app()
```

[`run_linkmapper()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/run_app.md),
[`validate_lm_file()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/validate_lm_file.md)
and
[`group_markers()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/group_markers.md)
from version 0.1 still work.

The analysis is also available as functions:

``` r

library(linkmapper)
d <- read_cross("my_population.raw")
d <- filter_markers(d, max_missing = 0.25)
g <- linkage_groups(d)
m <- order_groups(g, "record")
r <- scan_qtl(build_cross(d, m), n_perm = 1000)
plot_linkage_map(m, r)
```

## Demo data

[`linkmapper_demo()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/demo_info.md)
loads the simulated F2, backcross and RIL examples shipped with onemap,
and the 20-individual F2 file from the 2022 Linkmapper.

## History

Linkmapper was created in 2022 at the Kwame Nkrumah University of
Science and Technology (KNUST) by Ebenezer Ogoe, Michael Obeng and
Stephen Amoako. Version 0.2 (2026) is a rewrite as an R package with
backcross and RIL support, R/qtl-based QTL mapping, an interactive map
and reproducible exports. See `NEWS.md`.

## Citation

Run `citation("linkmapper")`, and cite onemap (Margarido et al. 2007;
Taniguti et al. 2023) and R/qtl (Broman et al. 2003).

## Licence

MIT. Linkmapper was created by Ebenezer Ogoe, Michael Obeng and Stephen
Amoako; the 2026 package was written and is maintained by Ebenezer Ogoe.

# Package index

## The app

- [`run_app()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/run_app.md)
  [`run_linkmapper()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/run_app.md)
  : Run the Linkmapper app

## Data

- [`read_cross()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/read_cross.md)
  : Read a genotype file
- [`add_traits()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/add_traits.md)
  : Add trait values to a dataset
- [`write_mapmaker()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/write_mapmaker.md)
  : Write a dataset in MAPMAKER format
- [`demo_info()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/demo_info.md)
  [`linkmapper_demo()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/demo_info.md)
  : Demo datasets
- [`validate_lm_file()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/validate_lm_file.md)
  : Check that a file can be read

## Quality control

- [`qc_summary()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/qc_summary.md)
  : Marker and individual quality summary
- [`filter_markers()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/filter_markers.md)
  : Filter markers

## Linkage groups and maps

- [`suggest_lod()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/suggest_lod.md)
  : Suggest a LOD threshold
- [`linkage_groups()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/linkage_groups.md)
  : Find linkage groups
- [`group_markers()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/group_markers.md)
  : Group markers (Linkmapper 0.1 interface)
- [`order_methods()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/order_methods.md)
  : Ordering algorithms
- [`order_groups()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/order_groups.md)
  : Order markers within each linkage group
- [`map_positions()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/map_positions.md)
  : Marker positions on a map
- [`map_summary()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/map_summary.md)
  : Summary of each linkage group

## QTL mapping

- [`build_cross()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/build_cross.md)
  : Build an R/qtl cross from a Linkmapper map
- [`qtl_methods()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/qtl_methods.md)
  : QTL mapping methods
- [`scan_qtl()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/scan_qtl.md)
  : Scan for QTL
- [`genotype_effect()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/genotype_effect.md)
  : Trait values by genotype at a marker

## Plots

- [`plot_effect()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_effect.md)
  : Trait values by genotype
- [`plot_linkage_map()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_linkage_map.md)
  : Draw a linkage map
- [`plot_lod()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_lod.md)
  : LOD profile plot
- [`plot_missing()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_missing.md)
  : Missing data plot
- [`plot_rf_heatmap()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_rf_heatmap.md)
  : Recombination fraction heatmap for one linkage group
- [`plot_segregation()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/plot_segregation.md)
  : Segregation test plot
- [`map_plot_size()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/map_plot_size.md)
  : Size of a linkage map figure in inches
- [`theme_linkmapper()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/theme_linkmapper.md)
  : ggplot2 theme used by Linkmapper

## Analyses, reports and sessions

  : Default analysis settings
- [`run_analysis()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/run_analysis.md)

- [`build_script()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/build_script.md)

  [`load_session()`](https://ebenogoe.github.io/linkmapper/reference/save_session.md)
